summary: ADR-0048 accepted 2026-07-26; repository source plus Accepted ADRs are fact authority; projections/indexes are derived_cache only; deterministic Locator returns locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence, never synthesized answers; consumers reread and hash-verify sources; trusted adapters bound domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence, LLM intent is untrusted and cannot widen scope; VDD records post-reread accept/reject, rejected candidates cannot fulfill required modules, uncovered modules block readiness; Quick Dev uses only VDD-frozen accepted decisions; Bootstrap Review may locate pre-prepare then freezes Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback default disabled, approved Python delegation only scripts/sc/_llm_backend.py::run_llm_exec; maintenance pins refs/heads/main with no implicit fetch/checkout/merge/branch mutation and append-only derived evidence; extends ADR-0044; complements ADR-0037/0041/0043, supersedes none; fail closed on missing/stale/low-confidence/out-of-policy/hash drift; no authorization for Phase routes, Hosted E2, live metadata, deployment, acceptance, handoff, release, commit.
